properties.name: A prohibition living in prose is noticed once as a practice — the routing table's Constraint row gets the leg that notices
properties.subject: system
properties.summary:
New gap source `prohibition_in_prose` in detect.rs, from the same morning's measurement (fact:capture-is-blind-to-three-families-…): capture-intent's routing table sends "a prohibition with no number in it" to a Constraint, NOT a Requirement, and the design went on writing them into prose — instruction present, detector absent.

THE RULE: one aggregate finding over live Requirements, Capabilities, Components, Interfaces and ACCEPTED Decisions whose name/statement/description/decision text contains one of six phrases ("must never", "must not ever", "is/are not allowed to", "never allowed", "is forbidden"), case-insensitive, with no incoming CONSTRAINS. Severity 0.35, beside unreviewed_ideas. Aggregate with a stable id — one acknowledgement is a judgement about the practice; per node it is the BL-73 wallpaper. The matched phrase rides into the evidence per node; the evidence carries the denominator.

EXCLUSIONS, each pinned by a test that fails when the rule is widened: proposed Decisions (the brainstorm skill's own rule — detectors do not run over ideas; once accepted the same sentence IS scanned); DesignRules and Constraints (both are homes); ChangeEvents, TemporalFacts, Verifications (records and checks, not intent); the rationale field; parked nodes. "shall not" deliberately not matched — the requirement idiom. The closed-set row not matched — "exactly one of" is ordinary API prose here and would flood.

MEASURED ON THE COMMITTED EXPORT BEFORE MERGE: 30 of 1,003 scanned nodes (Requirement 14, Capability 9, accepted Decision 7). Lower than the morning's ≈61 regex estimate, and the difference is the exclusions — that estimate also counted records, rationales and brainstormed ideas, which is exactly what the shipped rule refuses to nudge. 35 gaps in the design in total, so this is one of them.

FALSIFIED BOTH WAYS: detector disabled → the 5 positive tests fail; every exclusion widened at once (all types, all statuses, rationale included, CONSTRAINS ignored) → the 5 exclusion tests fail. 11 tests.

No regex crate added. Composition: detect-and-ask names the source (all three skill trees), skill_lint allowlists it, docs/gap-surfacing.md row, CHANGELOG.
